# CANDIDATE: SHOTGUN_SCALPER_STAGE5_TOP_COMBO

**Filed:** 2026-07-16  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We are trying to capture edge by adjusting exit parameters: increasing TP target to 75% of premium, tightening stop to 35% loss, reducing time stop to 12 minutes, adding chandelier profit-lock arm at 60% favor, and requiring vol ratio >1.2 for entry. The hypothesis is that these changes will let winners run faster while cutting losers sooner, improving edge on J's anchor days without increasing losers_added.

## Mechanism

Entry trigger remains the baseline shotgun_scalper setup (volume breakout with confluence filters). Exit logic: 
- TP1: sell at +75% premium (qty fraction 0.667) 
- Stop: hard exit at -35% premium 
- Time stop: forced exit after 12 minutes if neither TP nor stop hit 
- Chandelier: trails stop to arm_floor × (1 - 0.15) once armed at +60% premium 
- Volatility filter: only enter when current volume > 1.2 × 20-bar average volume
